cli.input: --input selects the party records file only; default /app/data/party_records.json

description: Output contract for the party-linkage engine. Shapes, paths, field lists, sort orders and what each summary counter counts; no derivation rule lives here.
output_dir_contents: after a run the output directory holds exactly the three files named under outputs and nothing else; any other file already sitting there when the run starts is removed before the artifacts are written, so a run never presents an earlier run's leftovers as its own output

golden_records.serialisation: JSON array, two-space indent, trailing newline

field_notes.member_count: how many records the cluster holds
field_notes.completeness: how many of the six compared fields -- given_name, family_name, street, city, postal_code, born_on -- the record carries a non-empty value for, judged after normalisation and on the assembled record rather than on the survivor

review_queue.serialisation: one compact JSON object per line, trailing newline
review_queue.sort: descending by score, then ascending by left then right

counters.block_count: distinct block keys built from those records, counting a key that holds a single record as much as one that holds many
counters.chain_broken_link_count: accepted links cut to leave a cohesive cluster, counted per link cut
counters.do_not_merge_block_count: pairs scoring at or above the match threshold that the register held apart, counted per pair
counters.link_count: qualifying pairs that linked: pairs scoring at or above the match threshold that the do-not-merge register does not hold apart, counted per pair and not per union, so a pair whose two records already share a cluster still counts
counters.merged_cluster_count: golden records whose member_count is greater than one
counters.oversized_cluster_count: clusters dissolved for exceeding the policy's maximum cluster size
counters.record_count: records read from the input party file
counters.review_count: rows written to the review queue

summary.serialisation: JSON object, two-space indent, trailing newline

party_records.serialisation: JSON array, two-space indent, trailing newline

units.loaded_on_day: integer day offset; smaller is earlier
units.score: integer points; the field weights sum to 110
